sections.name: Fixes from round 1
sections.use: Your Maybes, changed the way your notes said, plus a softer answer to "punchier on big moments" since the punchy hit was dropped.

sections.name: Colour: monochrome with dusty blue
sections.use: You kept Monochrome and Dusty blue. Same card, words and hard cut as round 1's monochrome; each option changes one thing to bring the blue in.

sections.name: Split screen with animation
sections.use: Your footage below, an animation above (Gannon, Cooperson, RPN). Same clip, same chart, same timing. Each option changes one thing. Open one to hear it.

sections.name: Animations on a plain background
sections.use: Full-screen explainer moments on the monochrome card, all moving with your kept smooth ease and carrying your kept sounds. Same story in each: one shoot day becomes a month of posts. Open one to hear it.

sections.name: A style from your Pinterest
sections.use: Five treatments taken straight from your VALE, BRAND and Creative boards, on the same walk-and-talk shot and the same line. Open one to hear it.

sections.name: UI cards over footage
sections.use: From justyn.ai: interface cards that sit on the shot, with polish and warmth. Same clip, same spot in the top band, same landing at 0.8 s with your kept soft click. Each option changes the card. Open one to hear it.

cards.label: Repeated stack, inside the safe zone
cards.desc: Fixes "not in safe zone": the rows grow to a 96px max so the widest fits inside the Reels safe area, with nothing under the buttons. Turn on Safe zones to check.

cards.label: Whoosh, shorter and softer
cards.desc: The whoosh cut to 320 ms and pulled down to a 1.4 kHz peak so it sits under the voice. Now on your kept snappy mask, peaking as the words land.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-f2.wav

cards.label: Whoosh, a breath of air
cards.desc: A longer, very low and soft air sweep (700 ms, 900 Hz peak), more felt than heard. On your kept smooth rise.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-f3.wav

cards.label: Big moment, softer
cards.desc: Instead of the dropped punchy hit: a short, round 70 Hz thud with a paper tap, no shake. Weight without noise, for the line that matters.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-f4.wav

cards.label: Blue key word
cards.desc: Monochrome, but the key word is a light dusty blue (#9DB0DA) instead of logo cream.

cards.label: Blue-black ground
cards.desc: The background shifts from warm off-black to a deep blue-black (#121722). Type and cream word unchanged.

cards.label: Light ground, blue word
cards.desc: Flipped: pale grey-white ground, off-black type, dusty blue key word (#3C5182).

cards.label: Blue details only
cards.desc: Monochrome card, cream key word, but the label, index and hairline turn dusty blue. The blue as a quiet accent.

cards.label: Monochrome panel, chart
cards.desc: Hard split at 940px. Warm off-black panel; the line chart draws itself while the number counts to 30. Line draw borrows the stroke-dash technique from the ideas library (ik-builds-585923).

cards.label: Light panel, dusty blue chart
cards.desc: The same split and chart on a pale grey-white panel with a dusty blue line.

cards.label: Floating card
cards.desc: Instead of a hard split, the chart sits on a rounded card floating over a softened, dimmed copy of the shot. Gannon-style.

cards.label: Monochrome panel, number only
cards.desc: The same hard split, but just the number counting up to 30, huge, with no chart. Simpler.

cards.label: Chart draws on
cards.desc: A line chart draws itself as the number counts to 30, then a soft click as the end dot lands. Line draw: stroke-dash (ik-builds-585923).
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-m1.wav

cards.label: Stat cards stack in
cards.desc: Three cards slide up and land one after another, each with a soft paper slide: 1 day, 30 posts, 0 stress.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-m2.wav

cards.label: Handwritten note draws on
cards.desc: The statement cuts in, then a handwritten note writes itself on with a hand-drawn arrow, with a film click as it starts.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-m3.wav

cards.label: Numbered list builds
cards.desc: A four-step list with hairlines drawing in; each step lights up in turn with a soft click: plan, film, edit, post.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r2-m4.wav

cards.label: B&W cinematic
cards.desc: The shot in black and white with heavy grain and a tape timecode counting, like your "TCR 00:48:18.25 PLAY LOCK" pin. Caption is Tom-style in ink with a soft glow so it reads on the white tee.
cards.source: Your voice plus a kept sound (synthesised)

cards.label: Printed photo
cards.desc: The shot as a print: cream border, blue-ink handwriting writing itself on in the margin, a small date. Analog, from your BRAND board.
cards.source: Your voice plus a kept sound (synthesised)

cards.label: Handwritten card
cards.desc: A full-screen paper card where blue ink writes the line on, like "Act like the person you want to become". No footage.
cards.source: Your voice plus a kept sound (synthesised)

cards.label: Dusty blue stack
cards.desc: "IT'S ALREADY YOURS" made Vale's: the line repeating and growing in dusty blue on pale grey, rows cutting in one by one, all inside the safe zone.
cards.source: Your voice plus a kept sound (synthesised)

cards.label: Retro sticker
cards.desc: A cream print sticker with the sun mark, slapped onto the shot at a slight angle. From your Creative board's stickers and matchbooks.
cards.source: Your voice plus a kept sound (synthesised)

cards.label: Prompt bar, light
cards.desc: A cream prompt bar drops in and types the line, with a round dark send button. justyn.ai's prompt bar in Vale colours.
cards.source: Soft click (kept, synthesised) under your voice

cards.label: Prompt bar, dark
cards.desc: The same prompt bar in the monochrome dark card with a cream send button.
cards.source: Soft click (kept, synthesised) under your voice

cards.label: Notification card
cards.desc: A phone-style notification slides down: "New enquiry" from a builder, with an initial avatar. Shows the result, not the tool.
cards.source: Soft click (kept, synthesised) under your voice

cards.label: Pill label
cards.desc: A small white pill drops in with one bold number. The lightest touch: "1 day of filming".
cards.source: Soft click (kept, synthesised) under your voice
